title: Winning the Leaderboard, Losing the Distribution: Diagnosing and Mitigating Acoustic Narrowing in Low-Resource ASR
abstract: arXiv:2611.18653v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For a low-resource language, one public leaderboard is often the only shared measure of progress, so optimizing toward it means optimizing toward a test distribution. Our low-rank fine-tune of whisper-large-v3-turbo ranked first on MediaSpeech, Common Voice 17 and a five-set Turkish community board, at 9.02% word error on MediaSpeech against 11.93% for the best baseline. On its private split it lost to unmodified whisper-large-v3. We treat that split as an alarm, not evidence; the main finding does not depend on it. On a twenty-condition FLEURS-TR benchmark built independently of our model selection, the unmodified base beats every fine-tune in every condition, and all five deficits clear zero under paired bootstrap. We call this acoustic narrowing: fine-tuning contracts the acoustic range a model serves well. The central finding is methodological: our in-house proxy for detecting narrowing concealed it instead, ranking the narrowed fine

translated_title: 赢得排行榜，失去分布：低资源语音识别中声学收窄的诊断与缓解
translated_abstract: 对于一种低资源语言来说，公开排行榜往往是唯一共享的进展衡量标准，因此朝它优化就意味着朝某个特定测试分布优化。我们对whisper-large-v3-turbo进行低秩微调后，在MediaSpeech、Common Voice 17和一个包含五个测试集的土耳其语社区排行榜上均排名第一，在MediaSpeech上词错误率为9.02%，而最佳基线为11.93%。然而在其私有划分上，它输给了未经修改的whisper-large-v3。我们将该结果视为警报而非证据，主要发现并不依赖于此。在一个独立于我们模型选择流程构建的、涵盖二十种条件的FLEURS-TR基准上，未经修改的基座模型在所有条件下都击败了所有微调版本，且五项性能差距在配对自助法检验下均显著大于零。我们将这种现象称为“声学收窄”：微调缩小了模型能够良好服务的声学范围。核心发现是方法学层面的：我们原本用于检测声学收窄的内部代理指标反而掩盖了这一问题，将收窄的微调模型排在……
tldr: 该论文发现，针对公开排行榜优化的低资源语音识别模型微调会导致“声学收窄”——尽管在排行榜上夺冠，模型在多种真实声学条件下的表现反而全面劣于未微调的基座模型，且内部检测代理指标会掩盖这一退化。
